claims.object_text: abundantly expressed in the large axon terminals of basket cells that make powerful axo-somatic synapses onto Purkinje cells
claims.quote: The gene Kcna2 encodes the voltage-gated potassium channel α-subunit Kv1.2, which is abundantly expressed in the large axon terminals of basket cells that make powerful axo-somatic synapses onto Purkinje cells.
an increase in GABA release from basket cells is involved in the motor incoordination in Pgu mice.
